title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with permission to edit playbooks and repositories could…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, users with roles permitting playbook and repository edits can insert modified utility blocks into playbooks. When another user with permission to edit playbook code opens and saves such a playbook, subsequent runs may issue REST API delete requests to unintended resources if the running user has delete permissions. This occurs because Splunk SOAR does not restrict utility blocks from altering REST API request paths.
